column1: # What the probe account answered on 2026-10-21 (D7), cell by cell: every cell CosmosOutcomeHarness.Holds measured, as
# runs.tsv wrote it before any assertion. An outcome whose On names Azure must find its answer here, or in an earlier
# record, for each of its cells (CosmosAxiomsTests.EveryAzureClaimHasARecordedRun).
# main at #237's merge (bab0d59), Release, net10.0, at 400 RU/s, every container deleted afterwards. The JSON type class
# passed 12 of 12, the boolean logic class 7 of 7, and the order class 10 of 11: ADocumentsStringsOrderByCodePoint failed,
# Azure ordering the strings holding U+0000 by code point where the row declared only the emulator's StoredCodePoint.
# Sql.CosmosFunctionBodiesTests did not run: it needs an Entra role assignment and a container made beforehand, and N13
# is held in the JSON type class over the same kinds (TheTypeTestBodiesAnswerWhatTheServiceAnswersOverEveryKind).
# Columns as 2026-10-16's. The witnesses are the catalogue's for the cell (CosmosOutcomeWitnesses), all of which Holds
# ran: a connective's those at c.v, each beside every witness of its operand's class at c.u; a row held over the rounding
# edges in its literal's place, every edge's.
# Every line was read as its pinning test reads it: a WHERE that keeps a witness is True, a WHERE NOT that keeps one is
# False, one neither keeps is Undefined, the literal sent as a parameter and a range's bounds as two; the projection,
# where it is a boolean or nothing, said the same at every cell no target declared NotKept. An order is the comparator
# that sorts the witnesses as ORDER BY does, ASC and DESC, and places them as > does beside each witness holding no U+0000,
# the two holding one among those placed. A line at a cell its row declares for no target was measured beside its key's
# and backs nothing, nor does a cell that answered two ways.
# EachKindTestIsTrueOfItsKindAlone: IS_STRING, IS_NUMBER, IS_BOOL, IS_OBJECT, IS_ARRAY (c.v)
# AComparisonWithinATypeIsTrueOrFalse: =, !=, <, <=, >, >= against @l, and = and != against true and false
# NotOverUndefinedIsUndefined: NOT c.v, NOT (c.v > "") for undefined, and two composites
# NOT (c.v = "bikes") at String answered False and True, a witness each, and backs nothing
# Measurements.CosmosBooleanLogicMeasurementTests, over c.v, a connective's first side at c.u
# TheConnectivesTreatEverythingButABooleanAsUnknown: (c.v OR true), NOT (c.v AND false), NOT (c.v OR false)
# TheConnectivesAreKleenesInEitherOrder: (u AND v), (u OR v), u of the operand's class at c.u, and NOT v
# ADocumentsStringsOrderByCodePoint: ORDER BY c.v over the order's witnesses, > beside each; c.v > @l, @l U+E000
# ARangeWhoseBoundsTheOrdersRankApartKeepsNothing: c.v >= @lo AND c.v <= @hi, U+E000 and U+1F600, B and a
# IntegersOrderExactly: ORDER BY c.v over the order's witnesses, > beside each; c.v = @l, @l 2^53 + 1
# NumbersBeyondLongCompareAsDoubles: =, !=, <, <=, >, >= against @l at 0.1, 2^53 + 1, 1e22 and 2^63 as a double
